# maiman.components

Every block the studio's palette offers, 77 of them, generated from the classes themselves. A component is a pure function of its inputs and its parameters, and its ports are typed (optical, electrical, binary, symbol, soft or metric), so a wire between two different types is refused while it is being drawn.
